name: menubarmijia
title: MenuBarHome
description: Search and control MenuBarHome devices, scenes and quick actions from Raycast. Runs through the app's menumijia:// links, so your Mi Home and Home Assistant credentials never leave the app.
author: jryang1997

commands.name: search-devices
commands.title: Search Devices
commands.subtitle: MenuBarHome
commands.description: Search the devices MenuBarHome shows and control power, brightness, colour temperature, thermostat target and fan speed.

commands.name: search-scenes
commands.title: Scenes & Quick Actions
commands.subtitle: MenuBarHome
commands.description: Run Home Assistant scenes and the built-in quick actions: all lights off, soft night light, sleep climate off, all off and undo.

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Ask MenuBarHome
commands.subtitle: MenuBarHome
commands.description: Send one natural-language command to the MenuBarHome assistant, using the same parsing and confirmation rules as the app.

preferences.name: snapshotPath
preferences.title: Snapshot Path
preferences.description: Leave empty to read ~/Library/Application Support/MenuBarMijia/raycast-snapshot.json. Set MENUBARMIJIA_SNAPSHOT_PATH to override it for every command.

preferences.name: waitTimeoutSeconds
preferences.title: Result Timeout
preferences.description: Seconds to wait for MenuBarHome to report the result of a command.
